correctness.rationale: Exact convex hulls follow from enriched antichain/filter definitions. Weighted cube sections yield a Beta(m+1,n) minimum law for the order body; signed-shell integration yields Dirichlet(m,n,1) radii for the chain body. Conditioned first and second moments give the full block matrices, matrix determinant lemma yields the rank-one ratio, and elementary factor bounds plus m=t^2,n=t yield the sharp supremum. Independent exact integer-fan triangulation recomputes both body moments in eight parameter pairs; rational identities checked for 22500 more pairs. The finite checks corroborate, not replace, the universal integral proof.

value.rationale: Enriched order and chain polytopes share Ehrhart data but need not share affine metrics; a complete tensor comparison is a motivated invariant gap. The new correction is exactly positive rank one supported on the common upper-level direction, with strict affine-invariant isotropic determinant inflation universally bounded by a sharp factor 4. This exact two-parameter structural law and extremal asymptotic provide a non-tabular quantitative distinction beyond existing volume and facet information.
